newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Costello says big bank mergers reduce competition.
newsitem.headline: Costello says big bank mergers reduce competition.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Thursday he wanted to keep in place the big four banks because there would be too much pressure if the number was reduced to two.

"Because if you allowed say two of the big four to merge the pressure would probably be on for the other two ... and four would become two," Costello told Australian Broadcasting Corp Radio on Thursday.
"And we think that the competition is not great enough at the moment and we couldn't see how it would be improved if four became two," he said.

"What we've said is let's get measures in place which will enhance competition in the existing system by allowing insurers to mutuals to come into the banking system, the possibility of a new foreign entrant."
"If we can improve competition, particularly for small business lending, we can have a look at that question down the track."
